item.title: Roadworks blocking our driveway and unable to move our skip, 12th October
item.description:
The issue is the Thames water roadworks REF: MU057CRANLEYGRDNS-TR that have been carrying out on Etheldene Avenue up to Cranley gardens since 9/10/26. They mentioned the works will be done end of October. I have just seen on the TFL website the work on this road have been proposed and the new end date is 17/11/2026. Furthermore builders have not been on site for the last three days and are busy elsewhere and it's just delaying it more. My father is unable to park his car in his own driveway and there is a skip that needs to be removed this Thursday. Is there any sort of compensation or solution to this problem?

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 94, Cranley Gardens, Muswell Hill, Greater London

item.title: Persistent fly tipping behind the grit bin on Hitherfield Road beside 50 Leigham Vale, 12th October
item.description:
There is almost weekly fly tipping occurring next to the yellow grit bin beside in Hitherfield Road. Items have included fridges (multiple occasions), general rubbish, dirty clothes, rotten food and furniture. Children and families regularly use this street to access the primary school and this rubbish causes a risk to their safety. In addition, the grit bin attracts other antisocial behaviour, including general littering, urination, and regular use as a smoking bench.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hitherfield Road, Streatham Hill, Greater London
